name: oxo-flow-fetchngs
title: nf-core fetchngs (port)
description: Fetch metadata and raw FastQ files from public databases (SRA/ENA/DDBJ/GEO) — oxo-flow port of nf-core/fetchngs: input-id check, ENA metadata fetch, FTP FastQ download with md5 verification, auto-created samplesheet + id mappings + MultiQC mappings config.
excluded: sratools download path (prefetch/fasterq-dump incl. sralite variant) — data-dependent per-run fallback for runs without FTP links, not on the default ftp path
aspera download path (ASPERA_CLI / fasp links) — download_method=aspera only
